nodes.label: QR Digital Menu SaaS Platform вЂ” root documentation corpus (22 files): architecture, roadmap, bugs, migrations, loyalty, AI import, POS, auth, translation
nodes.author: QR Menu Dev
nodes.rationale: Primary knowledge graph for 22 root-level markdown docs spanning 6 months of development from Docker-era MVP to V3 Growth phase

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md вЂ” primary AI guidance file: menu options JSON schema, loyalty rate semantics, never hardcode tier thresholds, never Promise.all inside $transaction, never change api.ts baseURL, JWT cookie rules, CSRF middleware ordering
nodes.author: QR Menu Dev
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for AI agents working on codebase; contains all critical architectural rules and gotchas

nodes.label: Happy hour points multiplier вЂ” uses Luxon with restaurant IANA timezone field (never raw new Date()), multiplier strategy is Math.max(happyHour, tier), not additive
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware prevents server UTC mismatches; Math.max prevents double-dipping on happy hour + VIP tier

nodes.label: MenuOption.choices JSON schema вЂ” always [{name: string, priceModifier: number}], no id field, price key is priceModifier NOT price
nodes.rationale: Critical schema constraint affecting every layer: DB/seed, ItemWithOptions, orders.service validation, CartContext totals. Wrong field name throws Invalid choice selected for every order with options

nodes.label: Server-side choice validation in orders.service.ts вЂ” matches c.name === selected.choiceName and reads choice.priceModifier
nodes.rationale: Never change to c.id or choice.price вЂ” those fields don't exist

nodes.label: API baseURL rule вЂ” api.ts MUST use /api (same-origin), NEVER read from VITE_API_URL directly. VITE_API_URL is ONLY for vite.config.js proxy target
nodes.rationale: Breaking this rule creates cross-origin requests, breaking httpOnly cookies. Repeated in CLAUDE.md as CRITICAL

nodes.label: Token storage rule вЂ” NEVER read token from localStorage. Token lives in httpOnly cookie only. Use /auth/me to get current user
nodes.rationale: httpOnly cookies are not accessible to JavaScript; localStorage would defeat XSS protection

nodes.label: CSRF middleware ordering in main.ts вЂ” Helmet CSP -> cookieParser -> CSRF validation -> app.useGlobalPipes. CSRF must run after cookieParser but before guards
nodes.rationale: Order matters: cookieParser must parse cookies before CSRF can validate them; CSRF must validate before guards process request

nodes.label: Prisma $transaction rule вЂ” NEVER use Promise.all over Prisma writes inside $transaction. Use updateMany instead
nodes.rationale: Promise.all inside $transaction causes race conditions on sequential writes

nodes.label: Tier threshold rule вЂ” never hardcode tier thresholds (500/2000) anywhere. Read from Restaurant row through loyalty-tiers.utils.ts
nodes.rationale: Thresholds are configurable per restaurant; hardcoding would break multi-tenant

nodes.label: Frontend tier consumption rule вЂ” consume tier info directly from API, do not recompute on client. CustomerProfilePage and CheckoutPage read tier from server response
nodes.rationale: Server is source of truth for tier calculation; client recomputation would diverge

nodes.label: DeepL API key rule вЂ” platform owns key via DEEPL_API_KEY env var. TranslationService methods take NO apiKey param. restaurant.deeplApiKey column exists in schema but is NEVER read or written
nodes.rationale: Platform-managed translation; restaurants don't need their own DeepL key

nodes.label: Payment provider rule вЂ” never add provider-specific logic outside the provider. Always go through IPaymentProvider interface
nodes.rationale: Enables future MyPOS/Square integration without touching business logic

nodes.label: NestJS module registration order вЂ” Prisma, Auth, Restaurants, Menu, Orders, Assistance, Dashboard, Tables, Health, Feedback, Translation, Storage, Events, Payment, Loyalty. ScheduleModule registered only in loyalty.module.ts
nodes.rationale: Module order affects dependency injection and middleware chain

nodes.label: @Max(100) on loyaltyExchangeRate in update-restaurant.dto.ts вЂ” prevents absurd point awards, most common cause of inflated loyalty points
nodes.rationale: Do not remove this constraint; past bug: exchange rate crept to 20 from default 10, giving double points

nodes.label: Backend clean script uses Windows rmdir /s /q вЂ” cross-platform users need rm -rf dist manually
nodes.rationale: Windows-specific command in package.json; known gotcha for Mac/Linux devs
